steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary diploma or equivalent and can document the required contact hours in project management education. steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the required education into an accelerated schedule, allowing you to master PMBOK® fundamentals and exam concepts without prolonged classroom commitments.

steps_items.text: Register with PMI and formally apply for CAPM candidacy through their portal. You'll provide proof of your secondary education and completion of the contact-hour requirement, then pay the associated exam fee to activate your testing eligibility.

steps_items.text: After earning your CAPM, commit to earning professional development units during the standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer numerous avenues—continuing education, volunteer work, and speaking engagements—to keep your credential active and your skills current.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
